title: shellless-rag-playground: devcontainer + e2e probes for local-first RAG authoring
author: Priya Nambiar
release_notes: Add a local-first, shellless RAG playground that runs in a devcontainer and includes smoke e2e probes and structured-output validators. Helpful for onboarding and demos; no infra required.
description:
Motivation: Enable engineers and product teams to iterate on RAG templates, tool-calling adapters, and structured-output checks without provisioning remote infra. This PR adds a compact, "shellless" playground that runs in a devcontainer (or CI) and ships a tiny headless runner that exercises tool-calls, prefix caching, and structured output validators. It is intended as a local-first authoring surface for prompt engineers and SDK users to iterate quickly before promoting to hosted/Dedicated environments.

What this PR contains: - A new example under examples/rag-shellless that demonstrates: a minimal devcontainer, a lightweight headless runner (TypeScript + WASM-friendly shims), three sample tools (search, snippet-store, http-proxy stubs), and a set of stepwise prompt templates. - E2E smoke probes in tests/e2e that run the headless runner against the sample tools and validate structured JSON output using lightweight assertions. - Devcontainer + Dockerfile tuned for low-memory CI usage and reproducible builds. - A docs page (docs/rag/shellless-playground.md) with quickstart steps, portability notes, and guidance for promoting templates to Redwood hosted/Dedicated environments. - A CI workflow to run the smoke probes on PRs under scripts/ci/rag-smoke.yml.

Checklist: - [x] Add example files and README - [x] Add devcontainer + Dockerfile - [x] Add headless TS runner and tool stubs - [x] Add e2e smoke probes and CI workflow - [x] Docs page and quickstart (single-file copy/paste commands) - [x] Unit and e2e tests passing in CI (flaky test retried once)

Quickstart (copy/paste): 1) git clone ... && cd examples/rag-shellless 2) code . (open in VS Code and "Reopen in Container") OR docker build -t rag-shellless . && docker run --rm -it rag-shellless 3) npm run smoke:local (runs headless runner + local tool stubs) 4) npm run validate:outputs (runs structured-output assertions)

Notes for reviewers: - Focus on the developer experience story (README and docs) and the smoke probe coverage for the common failure modes: tool-call routing, JSON schema drift, and KV-prefetch semantics. - The headless runner is intentionally minimal; it should be easy to copy into other examples. We plan follow-ups to add a Go and Python shim.

Security: Tool stubs are sandboxed; devcontainer limits network egress by default and CI workflow runs in isolated runners. There are no credentials or customer data baked into the example.

Related: ENG-7482 (local authoring initiative), PM-314 (playground for onboarding), SUP-2317 (customer asked for faster repro workflow).

Commits summary: - Add shellless example skeleton and README - Devcontainer + Dockerfile for reproducible local runs - Implement TS headless runner + tool stubs - Add smoke e2e probes and structured-output validators - Add CI workflow rag-smoke.yml - Docs: add shellless-playground.md and crosslinks

If you want to run this locally without VS Code devcontainers: docker build -t rag-shellless . && docker run --rm -e RAG_MODE=local rag-shellless npm run smoke:local
